entries.title: Job 24:1
segments: ¶Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?

entries.title: Job 24:2
segments: [Some] remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed [thereof]. {feed...: or, feed them}

entries.title: Job 24:3
segments: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow's ox for a pledge.

entries.title: Job 24:4
segments: They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together.

entries.title: Job 24:5
segments: Behold, [as] wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: the wilderness [yieldeth] food for them [and] for [their] children.

entries.title: Job 24:6
segments: They reap [every one] his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked. {corn: Heb. mingled corn, or, dredge} {they gather...: Heb. the wicked gather the vintage}

words.text: . {corn: Heb. mingled corn, or, dredge} {they gather...: Heb. the wicked gather the vintage}

entries.title: Job 24:7
segments: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that [they have] no covering in the cold.

entries.title: Job 24:8
segments: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.

entries.title: Job 24:9
segments: They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor.

entries.title: Job 24:10
segments: They cause [him] to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf [from] the hungry;

entries.title: Job 24:11
segments: [Which] make oil within their walls, [and] tread [their] winepresses, and suffer thirst.

entries.title: Job 24:12
segments: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not folly [to them].

entries.title: Job 24:13
segments: ¶They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.

entries.title: Job 24:14
segments: The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy, and in the night is as a thief.

entries.title: Job 24:15
segments: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth [his] face. {disguiseth...: Heb. setteth his face in secret}

words.text: . {disguiseth...: Heb. setteth his face in secret}

entries.title: Job 24:16
segments: In the dark they dig through houses, [which] they had marked for themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.

entries.title: Job 24:17
segments: For the morning [is] to them even as the shadow of death: if [one] know [them, they are in] the terrors of the shadow of death.

entries.title: Job 24:18
segments: ¶He [is] swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.

entries.title: Job 24:19
segments: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: [so doth] the grave [those which] have sinned. {consume: Heb. violently take}

entries.title: Job 24:20
segments: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.

words.text: on him; he shall be no more remembered

entries.title: Job 24:21
segments: He evil entreateth the barren [that] beareth not: and doeth not good to the widow.

entries.title: Job 24:22
segments: He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no [man] is sure of life. {no...: or, he trusteth not his own life}

words.text: . {no...: or, he trusteth not his own life}

entries.title: Job 24:23
segments: [Though] it be given him [to be] in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes [are] upon their ways.

entries.title: Job 24:24
segments: They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all [other], and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn. {are gone: Heb. are not} {taken...: Heb. closed up}

entries.title: Job 24:25
segments: And if [it be] not [so] now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?
